title: Black Friday: the 7-point creative check
hook: Running Black Friday ads this weekend? Seven checks before you hit publish.
caption:
Running Black Friday ads this weekend? Seven checks before you hit publish.

Most sale ads slip on small things. The offer shows up late, or the page shows a different price from the ad.

These seven checks cover the ad, the click and what you will learn from it. They take a couple of minutes per ad.

The last slide has all seven in one place. Save it, run it on every ad going live, and have a good sale.

Follow @galvor.ai.
alt_text: Reel: seven checks before Black Friday ads go live.

script.setup: Phone screen recording of an ad about to be published, then quick text cards for each check. Fast cuts.

scenes.visual: Finger hovering over Publish on a sale ad.
scenes.voiceover: Before your Black Friday ad goes live, seven checks.

scenes.visual: Ad frame with the offer, muted icon, end date.
scenes.voiceover: Is the offer in the first frame? Does it read with the sound off? Is the end date on screen and in the caption?
scenes.on_screen: Offer first. Sound off. End date.

scenes.visual: Ad next to its landing page, same price circled.
scenes.voiceover: Does the page show the same price? Is the product in the ad actually in stock?

scenes.visual: A grid of ads, one highlighted as different. A note: 'we expect…'
scenes.voiceover: Does each ad have one clear difference from the rest? And did you write down what you expect before launch?

scenes.visual: All seven checks on one card.
scenes.voiceover: Two minutes per ad. Save this for every sale.
